description: Edit flows.jsn and reload the engine (no restart). Give ONE of: flow (a whole rule object; replaces the rule with the same id or adds it), delete (flow id), variable {id,name,init} / delete_variable, hook {id,name,met,url,body,err,gap} / delete_hook, or file (the complete flows.jsn). The rule is validated against the controller's card rules first; nothing is written on error. dry_run=true only validates. Card format (keys are short): WHEN t=sens{src:thermo|hum|usens, ch|id, op:gt|lt, val x10, hyst x10} | scmp | out{id, dir 0 off/1 on/2 any} | time{min, days} | sun{ev:rise|set, off} | var{id, op, val} | boot; AND t=sens | scmp | out{id, on 0|1} | twin{from, to, days} | var; THEN t=rel|grp{id, act 0 off/1 on/2 toggle} | pca|fet{id, val 0..255} | delay{s|m} | var{id, op:set|inc|dec, val} | log{val} | msg | http{id: webhook slot, val}. days = bitmask bit0=Mon..bit6=Sun (127 = every day); minutes of day for time/twin; temperatures x10 (21.5 °C = 215). Full reference: myio_reference topic=flow. Editor/admin level.
name: myio_flow_save
title: Create / change / delete Flow rules
